scripts.build:studio-worker: bun build studio/src/worker.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile target/studio/worker.js
scripts.build:studio-runtime: bun run build:studio-worker && bun build studio/src/controller.ts --target browser --outfile target/studio/controller.js
scripts.build:studio: bun run build:studio-runtime && bun build studio/src/main.ts --target browser --outfile target/studio/main.js
scripts.build:ts-app: bun build toolchains/ts/app.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile target/apps/ts/app.js
